affordance_in_statement: The packet you place first arrives at a time equal to its own arrival delay (p1). Each subsequent packet arrives exactly p1 seconds after the arrival of the packet immediately preceding it in the sequence. (Thus, a packet's arrival time is the sum of the arrival delays of all packets up to and including itself).
removal_suggestion: Re-present the same process indirectly as a packet-release clock: choosing a packet advances a separate release clock by that packet's first value, and the packet becomes available when that clock reaches its new value. Avoid explicitly naming the values as arrival delay and processing duration and avoid spelling out the cumulative-sum characterization.
